integrity: Analytic proof uses Katori-Shirai elliptic determinant and a derived strictly concave strip-Poisson theta interaction; numerical checker supports but does not prove universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-radius distinct observations, fixed prescribed interior radius, standard positive weighted annular Szegő kernel; explicit stability coefficient need not be sharp, no E-optimality or independent priority certification.
title: Universal regular-polygon D-optimality and global stability for weighted annular Szegő sampling
